t: Report On Mr. T.L. Shen, March 30, 1929

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No D 141

I.C. Chinese Section Station,
REPORT
Date March 30, 19 29.

Subject (in full) Mr. T. L. Shen (沈体兰).

Made by C.D.I. Prince. Forwarded by

Reference to the attached, Mr. T. L. Shen (沈体兰).
a native of Kiangsu, about 34 years of age, was a graduate of
the Soochow University, Soochow. Mr. Shen was the leader of
the Chinese delegates to the World Students Christian Federation
which held its annual Conference at Mysore (India) in December
1928. He is one of the secretaries of the Students Department
of the Y.M.C.A., National Committee of China, No. 20 Museum
Road. He returned to Shanghai from India about one week ago.
We have nothing in Police records, or otherwise
known to us, as result of inquiries, concerning this man.

A. C. P. Pol..
C. D. I.

C. I. D. Reg.
Kindly draft a reply to Col. Halland
with the above license.
30/3/29.

档案编号 D 141

虹口捕房华员股，
报告
日期：1929年3月30日。

事由（全称）：沈体兰先生 (Mr. T. L. Shen)。

制作人：刑事侦缉探员 Prince。转呈人：

关于附件，沈体兰先生 (Mr. T. L. Shen)，江苏人，约34岁，毕业于苏州东吴大学。沈先生是1928年12月在迈索尔（印度）举行年会的世界基督教学生联合会中国代表团团长。他是位于博物馆路20号的中国全国基督教青年会学生部秘书之一。他约于一周前从印度返回上海。经查询，警方档案中并无此人记录，我们也未通过其他途径获悉有关此人的任何情况。

助理警务处长。
刑事侦缉探员。

刑事侦缉处登记室。
请根据上述许可草拟给 Halland 上校的复信。
1929年3月30日。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 141
Date 27. 3. 29

SECRET

H. B. M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.
26th. March, 1929.

My dear Aiers,

I shall be much obliged if you will kindly
furnish me with any information available in your Depart-
ment regarding one, Mr. T.L. Shen, the leader of the Chinese
delegates to the World Students Christian Federation which
held its annual conference at Mysore (India) in December 1928.
On the 27th. of November, 1928, Mr. T.L.Shen delivered a
lecture at Madura (Madras) to the Y.M.C.A. on "some aspira-
tions of New China). In January 1929 he was lecturing on
"the youth movement in China" at Calcutta. It is reported
that Mr. T. L. Shen is the Secretary of the Student Depart-
ment of the Y.M.C.A. in China.

Yours sincerely,
C.H.A. Hallam

R. C. Aiers, Esq.,
Assistant Commissioner of Police,
Criminal Investigation Department,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（批：A.C.(Pol)）
（批：27/3）
（批：LCA）
（批：Chinese Section, For very careful inquiry and report please.）
（批：J.R. 27.3.29.）

英国驻上海总领事馆，
上海。
1929年3月26日。

亲爱的 Aiers：

如蒙贵部门提供关于沈体兰先生 (Mr. T.L. Shen) 的任何现有资料，我将不胜感激。沈先生是1928年12月在迈索尔（印度）举行年会的世界基督教学生联合会中国代表团团长。1928年11月27日，沈体兰先生在马杜赖（马德拉斯）向基督教青年会发表题为“新中国的一些愿望”的演讲。1929年1月，他在加尔各答就“中国的青年运动”发表演讲。据报，沈体兰先生是中国基督教青年会学生部秘书。

此致
敬礼，
C.H.A. Hallam

R. C. Aiers 先生，
助理警务处长，
刑事侦缉处，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

（批注：助理警务处长）
（批注：3月27日）
（批注：LCA）
（批注：华员股，请进行非常细致的调查并具报。）
（批注：J.R. 1929年3月27日。）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C: I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D.: 141
Date......8. 6. 29.

April 6th, '29

Dear Colonel.

In reply to your letter of March 26,
inquiries show that Mr. T. L. Shen is a native of
Kiangsu, about 34 years of age whose Shanghai address
is No. 43 Yuen Ming Li (源茂里), Tien Doong Road,
Chapei.

Shen is a graduate of Soochow University
and has been employed by the Y.M.C.A. National Committee
of China for the past seven years. He is a member of
the Kuomintang, but has never come into prominence in
connection with political activities in China.

Yours sincerely,
[Signature]

Lt. Col. G.H.R. Halland, O.B.E.,
North China Command.

日期：1929年6月8日

1929年4月6日

亲爱的上校：

回复您3月26日的来信，经查，沈体兰先生系江苏人，约34岁，其上海住址为闸北天通庵路源茂里43号。

沈先生毕业于东吴大学，过去七年间受雇于中国全国基督教青年会。他是国民党党员，但在中国的政治活动中从未崭露头角。

此致
敬礼，
[签名]

G.H.R. Halland 中校，O.B.E.勋衔，
华北司令部。

Date APRIL 4th, 19 29.

Subject (in full) Mr. L. K. Shen.

Made by C.D.I. J.W. Prince Forwarded by [签名] [签名]

Reference to my report of March 30th attached,
further diligent inquiries have failed to learn anything of
import regarding L. K. Shen.
He lives at No. 43 Yuen Ling Li (源发里),
Tien Doong Road, Chapei, and has been employed by the Y.M.C.A.
National Committee of China for the last seven years. He is
a member of the Kuomintang Party, but nothing further is
known to us of his activities in this direction, or any other
connections he may have in Shanghai.

6. I. D. By. 4/4/29

and include the
further information given above
